is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles funestus.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper investigates gene expression (transcriptomics) and functional validation (RNAi) of GSTe genes. It does not report genotype frequencies for any of the specified insecticide-resistance markers (SNPs, CNVs, or SVs).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not report genotype counts or frequencies for any resistance markers.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses field-collected Anopheles funestus from Cameroon, Ghana, Benin, Malawi, and Uganda.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study involving RNA-seq and RNAi experiments.

sub_country_location.evidence: The paper specifies locations such as Mibellon (Cameroon), Obuasi (Ghana), Kpome (Benin), Chikwawa (Malawi), and Tororo (Uganda).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collection years are provided (e.g., 2015 and 2019 for Mibellon, 2014 for others).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new RNA-seq and RNAi experiments on field-collected mosquitoes.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report genotype data, so no supplementary genotype data is needed.

assessment.summary: This study performs RNA-seq and RNAi-based functional validation to investigate the role of GST epsilon genes in insecticide resistance in Anopheles funestus across several African countries. It does not report genotype data for resistance markers.
